# Rebecca Nwose Photography

> Premier Portrait, Beauty, Fashion, Maternity & Lifestyle Photographer in Lagos, Nigeria.

Rebecca Nwose is a professional photographer and founder of RNstudio based in Lagos, Nigeria. RNstudio creates clean, natural, editorial, and timeless portraiture with masterfully controlled lighting and authentic storytelling.

## Core Photography Services
- **Beauty & Fashion Photography**: High-end editorial beauty portraits, skin-focused aesthetics, creative lighting, and commercial campaigns.
- **Portrait Photography**: Studio portraits, executive headshots, creative personal branding, and fine art portraits in Lagos.
- **Maternity Photography**: Elegant, artistic maternity photoshoots celebrating motherhood with studio lighting or on-location sets.
- **Family Portraiture**: Meaningful, natural family portraits capturing genuine connection and joy.
- **Couple Portraits**: Intimate engagement sessions, anniversary shoots, and editorial couple portraiture.

## Location & Service Area
- **Studio Location**: Lagos, Nigeria
- **Service Area**: Lagos (Lekki, Ikoyi, Victoria Island, Ikeja, Surulere) and available for destination travel worldwide.
- **Official Website**: https://rebeccanwose.com/
